name: adt-repair
description: Audit and repair an existing ADT using its source PDF and optional teacher or reviewer notes.

interface.longDescription: For textbook production teams: audit and repair an existing Accessible Digital Textbook (ADT) using its original PDF and optional teacher or reviewer notes. Inspect source pages and digital sections, derive book-specific styles and reusable components, repair layouts and assets, check activities, and produce a standalone review report. Preserve the existing reader, content bindings, navigation, languages and saved-response contracts. Requires local desktop execution, Python, Node.js, Poppler and a Chromium browser; dependencies are installed separately. This is an agent workflow with local helpers, not an automatic converter or an accessibility certification. Some books need book-specific adapters and human review. The plugin has no hosted service or telemetry endpoint; model processing follows the user's Codex account and settings.
defaultPrompt: Audit and repair my ADT folder using its source PDF and any teacher or reviewer notes.
Compare these ADT sections with the PDF and produce an issue report before making changes.
Update this book's shared components while preserving its reader, languages and working activities.
